properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): record-then-decide already WORKS for a cause that is not yet a node. record_finding accepts no caused_by, and create_edge draws CAUSES later (even with validation_status). But step ⑧ presents caused_by-in-the-same-call as THE route, and the refusal for an unresolved cause says "use its constructor", which sends the agent into the inversion the reporter hit
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL on dev_storyflow's 2026-09-24 entry (session 3bd108ab), triage of 2026-09-28.

① OBSERVED, verbatim: "the root-cause skill's step ⑧ says record the cause with `record_finding` + `caused_by`, but a cause that is a CLASS ('spells had no stated storage contract') has no node to point `caused_by` at until the Decision that fixes it exists — so the natural order (record cause, then decide) is inverted. I recorded the analysis as a Verification (method analysis) instead." Expected: the cause recorded first, the decision afterwards. NOT affected: a cause that is already a node.

② PRECEDENT: this is sighting ② of dec:idea-the-thing-you-need-to-point-at-is-usually-not-a-node-yet (hxm_program O-10, 2026-09-09): "the failure CLASS named by root-cause step ⑥ has nowhere to live but prose". Same modelling gap, now seen independently from a second project. Also hxm F-18 there, with a file as the cause.

③ CANDIDATES: (a) TOOL — record_finding refuses an unresolved caused_by and offers no deferred edge, so the order is forced (the reporter's reading). (b) INSTRUCTION — the tool does not force the order, but nothing on the path names the deferred route. (c) MODELLING — the fixing Decision is the wrong endpoint anyway. CAUSES from the fix would assert that the fix caused the defect. For "no stated storage contract", the design's Contract bone names the honest source: the Interface or Component whose contract is unstated. (d) THE OBSERVATION IS WRONG — the inversion is not real.

④ DISCRIMINATOR: (a) predicts that record_finding with no caused_by is refused or nags, or that a later CAUSES edge onto a TemporalFact is refused. (b) and (d) predict both succeed silently.

⑤ RESULT, reflow2-mcp 0.72.0, scratch store: record_finding with caused_by: dec:spells-storage-contract (not yet created) was REFUSED: "no node with id … exists under any type … if you meant to CREATE this node, use its constructor". The reporter's observation HOLDS. record_finding with NO caused_by was ACCEPTED, and the reply was {caused_by: null, finding, subject} with no word about the absent cause. create_edge CAUSES from ifc:spells-store (an Interface with an empty spec, minted AFTER the finding) to the finding was ACCEPTED, carrying validation_status: validated and basis: causal. record_finding cannot take those ("unknown field `validation_status`"). ⇒ (a) is REFUTED as the cause of the inversion: the tool supports record-then-decide. (b) HOLDS. Step ⑧ says "Pass `caused_by` and `cause_evidence` together" and names create_edge only "for a cause you are drawing between two records that already exist". The refusal points at creating the missing node now, which is the inversion itself. (c) HOLDS as the modelling half.

⑥ CLASS: an instruction presents one route as THE route, and the refusal for the case it does not fit points away from the route that works. It is one instance of this triage's class finding (fact:root-cause-instructions-route-records-to-paths-that-cannot-take-them-and-the-lint-checks-names-only-2026-09-28), with C1 and C3. THE COST WAS REAL: the analysis landed as a Verification (method analysis), so a root-cause write-up now counts as a CHECK in that project's verification rollups.

PINNING TEST (not written): record_finding's refusal for an unresolved caused_by names the deferred route (record without caused_by, then create_edge CAUSES), and the served root-cause skill's step ⑧ contains that route. Fails today on both.

THE REPORTER'S IDEA (C-i) is not minted as a separate Decision. Its two options are appended as a new sighting to dec:idea-the-thing-you-need-to-point-at-is-usually-not-a-node-yet, the idea that already asks this.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether storyflow's design has an Interface or Component for spells storage (their graph); whether the method-analysis Verification actually moved any of their rollups.

REPORTER'S CONCLUSIONS: "a class has no node to point caused_by at" HOLDS for a class as such, since there is no node type for one (the open idea). "until the Decision that fixes it exists" is OVERTURNED: the fixing Decision is not the cause. "the natural order is inverted" is OVERTURNED for the tool and HOLDS for the instruction, because nothing on the path says record-then-decide works.
